explanation: Refused: the requested kinematic point (W=2.0 GeV, Q2=3.0 GeV^2) is not accessible with a 2.2 GeV electron beam. Preflight check (exclurad_preflight_check) reports that this point requires an energy transfer nu = 3.261 GeV, which exceeds the total beam energy of 2.2 GeV -- i.e. the electron would need to lose more energy than it has. This is a hard kinematic/energy-conservation violation, not a tuning issue, so no input file can be generated for this beam energy. To proceed, either (a) raise the beam energy to at least ~3.3-3.5 GeV (comfortably above nu=3.261 GeV plus the scattered-electron energy needed to also supply Q2=3.0 GeV^2), for example using one of the standard CLAS12 energies (6.53 GeV default for eta, or 10.2/10.6 GeV), or (b) lower W and/or Q2 to values reachable at 2.2 GeV beam energy. No EXCLURAD input file was written.
